title: Templates for this module
body: Copy-ready structures you can reuse in your own engagements. Examples are fictional.

lines.label: Fields
lines.text: Learner ID, asset ID, artifact/version, evidence location, required fields complete, assumptions, source IDs, self-score, assessor, revision history

lines.label: Fictional example
lines.text: One versioned package with A01–A19 as applicable, two workflow pairs, value model and live/recorded executive readout.

lines.label: Acceptance check
lines.text: All required evidence present; no real customer names/data in the simulation.
